title: Evaluation of Decision-Making Fatigue After Traumatic Brain Injury
official: Evaluation of Decision-Making Fatigue After Traumatic Brain Injury (EDIFY)
summary: This is a preliminary, prospective, cohort study to investigate the feasibility of using the COGED and Restless Bandit tasks after a mild to moderate traumatic brain injury as well as in healthy controls.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria for TBI Participants:

* Adults 18 years and older
* Diagnosis of a mild to moderate TBI (GCS \> 8 on admission)
* Able to perform a computerized assessment
* Willing to attend all scheduled appointments
* Able to undergo the informed consent process

Inclusion Criteria for Healthy Participants:

* Adults 18 years and older
* Able to perform a computerized assessment
* Willing to attend all scheduled appointments
* Able to undergo the informed consent process
